title.es: Plan de estudios: entrada a AI aplicado (2026)
title.en: Study plan: getting into applied AI (2026)

name.es: AI Product Engineer o AI-native Frontend
name.en: AI Product Engineer or AI-native Frontend

summary.es: El frontend full-stack es la ventaja, no el deficit: construir el producto LLM completo, de la API al chat. Excluyente real: un producto LLM en produccion con UI propia. Es la variante mas cercana a la taxonomia de Aplicacion y Negocio, con el Forward Deployed como titulo vecino que mas crece.
summary.en: Full-stack frontend is the advantage, not the gap: building the whole LLM product, from API to chat UI. Real must-have: a production LLM product with its own UI. It maps closest to the Application and Business job types, with Forward Deployed as the fastest-growing neighbouring title.

name.es: AI Automation Engineer o AI Agent Developer
name.en: AI Automation Engineer or AI Agent Developer

summary.es: La via con menos friccion, porque no compite con ingenieros de ML formales: flujos de agentes que automatizan procesos de negocio. Excluyente real: un flujo de agentes funcionando de punta a punta y poder explicar el proceso de negocio que automatiza.
summary.en: The lowest-friction path, since it does not compete with trained ML engineers: agent workflows that automate business processes. Real must-have: an end-to-end agent workflow running and the ability to explain the business process it automates.

name.es: SWE senior en un equipo de producto AI
name.en: Senior SWE on an AI product team

summary.es: Entrar como ingeniero senior a un equipo que ya hace AI y aprender por simbiosis, en vez de re-venderse como junior de ML sin probado. Mantiene seniority y salario, y es la ruta que mas se recomienda en la comunidad y la que mas se parece a como entran realmente los perfiles.
summary.en: Joining a team that already ships AI as a senior engineer and learning by osmosis, instead of reselling yourself as an unproven ML junior. Keeps seniority and pay, and it is the most recommended route in the community and the closest to how people actually enter the role.

antiList.es: No pagar un bootcamp caro de ML/AI pensando que es la puerta de entrada.
antiList.en: Do not pay for an expensive ML/AI bootcamp thinking it is the entry door.

antiList.es: No arrancar por algebra lineal, calculo, PyTorch o entrenamiento de redes si el objetivo es AI Engineer aplicado: esa ruta forma researchers.
antiList.en: Do not start with linear algebra, calculus, PyTorch or training networks if the goal is applied AI engineering: that path trains researchers.

antiList.es: No hacer la Deep Learning Specialization completa antes de tocar RAG.
antiList.en: Do not complete the whole Deep Learning Specialization before touching RAG.

antiList.es: No presentarse como Prompt Engineer: el titulo se absorbio en otros roles.
antiList.en: Do not present yourself as a Prompt Engineer: the title got absorbed into other roles.

antiList.es: No aplicar a ML Engineer junior ni a MLOps junior con este plan: son perfiles distintos y requieren mas de lo que el plan cubre.
antiList.en: Do not apply to junior ML Engineer or junior MLOps roles with this plan: they are different profiles and need more than the plan covers.

antiList.es: No agregar skills al CV sin uso real defendible. Vale para AI igual que para frontend.
antiList.en: Do not add skills to the CV without real, defensible use. It applies to AI the same way it applies to frontend.

exitSignals.es: Fase 3 completada con el proyecto RAG desplegado: se puede empezar a aplicar a roles de automatizacion y agentes y a posiciones que pidan RAG con UI.
exitSignals.en: Phase 3 completed with the RAG project deployed: you can start applying to automation and agent roles and to positions asking for RAG with a UI.

exitSignals.es: Fase 5 completada con el asistente desplegado y evals en CI: cobertura de los tres roles, incluido AI Product Engineer.
exitSignals.en: Phase 5 completed with the assistant deployed and evals in CI: coverage of all three target roles, including AI Product Engineer.

exitSignals.es: Cada proyecto entra a la busqueda con su error analysis publicado: taxonomia de fallos con numeros antes y despues. Es la respuesta a la pregunta de evaluacion de las entrevistas.
exitSignals.en: Every project goes into the job search with its error analysis published: a failure taxonomy with before and after numbers. It is the answer to the evaluation question in interviews.

exitSignals.es: Los proyectos entran al CV solo con despliegue y URL viva.
exitSignals.en: Projects only enter the CV once deployed with a live URL.

exitSignals.es: Cambiar el posicionamiento del CV hacia AI es una decision aparte. Si se toma, buscar tambien por AI Product Engineer, Full Stack AI Engineer y Forward Deployed: buscar solo por AI Engineer deja fuera a la mayoria del talento y de las ofertas.
exitSignals.en: Shifting the CV positioning toward AI is a separate decision. If taken, also search for AI Product Engineer, Full Stack AI Engineer and Forward Deployed: searching only for AI Engineer misses most of the talent and most postings.
